design.title: Sustainable extraction
design.question: Does faster resource regeneration prevent collapse of a shared stock?

limitations: Stylized logistic resource dynamics, without geography or calibrated ecology.
Scripted demonstration of the viewer and rules; not evidence of model behavior.

observation.rules: Share a persistent stock with capacity 60. Each round submit a sealed extraction request from 0 to 8. After all choose, requests exceeding stock are rationed proportionally. Each extracted unit earns one credit. Remaining stock grows by 0.1 * remaining * (1 - remaining/capacity). Extracting everything causes irreversible collapse and ends the run. Choices/messages are revealed together at settlement. Target is empty. Report states your private signal, unrelated to stock; promise and forecast are null.
